Prometheus Rules:
{Groups:[{Name:takecare-demo File:/etc/prometheus/rules.yml Interval:5 Rules:[{Name:HighLatencyP99 Query:http_request_duration_seconds{quantile="0.99"} > 2 Duration:300 Labels:{severity="warning"} Annotations:{description="P99 latency of {{ $labels.service }} has been {{ $value | printf \"%.2f\" }}s for 5 minutes.", summary="P99 latency above 2s on {{ $labels.service }}"} Alerts:[] Health:ok LastError: EvaluationTime:0.000388917 LastEvaluation:2026-11-11 09:12:24.48773943 +0000 UTC State:inactive} {Name:HighErrorRate Query:sum by (service, namespace) (rate(http_requests_total{status="504"}[1m])) / sum by (service, namespace) (rate(http_requests_total[1m])) > 0.02 Duration:30 Labels:{severity="critical"} Annotations:{description="{{ $value | humanizePercentage }} of {{ $labels.service }} requests have answered 504 for 30 seconds.", summary="High error rate on {{ $labels.service }}"} Alerts:[] Health:ok LastError: EvaluationTime:0.00031725 LastEvaluation:2026-11-11 09:12:24.488155305 +0000 UTC State:inactive} {Name:PodNotReady Query:kube_pod_status_ready{condition="true",namespace="demo-apps"} == 0 Duration:300 Labels:{severity="warning"} Annotations:{description="The pod has not reached the Ready state for 5 minutes.", summary="Pod {{ $labels.namespace }}/{{ $labels.pod }} not ready"} Alerts:[] Health:ok LastError: EvaluationTime:0.000176833 LastEvaluation:2026-11-11 09:12:24.488481013 +0000 UTC State:inactive} {Name:PodCrashLooping Query:increase(kube_pod_container_status_restarts_total{namespace="demo-apps"}[15m]) > 3 Duration:300 Labels:{severity="critical"} Annotations:{description="More than 3 restarts in 15 minutes.", summary="Pod {{ $labels.namespace }}/{{ $labels.pod }} restarting repeatedly"} Alerts:[] Health:ok LastError: EvaluationTime:0.000115417 LastEvaluation:2026-11-11 09:12:24.488664555 +0000 UTC State:inactive}]}]}
